name: Spanish Cobras
description: The Insane Spanish Cobras Nation are a primarily Latino (Puerto Rican/Mexican) Folk Nation street gang based on Chicago's North and West sides. Their founding is disputed — some accounts cite 1958 in Bridgeport, others the early 1970s in East Humboldt Park — with Richard 'King Cobra' Medina introducing the 'Insane' prefix around 1975. In 1989, the Cobras, Maniac Latin Disciples, and Two Sixers co-founded Spanish Growth and Development (SGD), modeled on the Chicago Outfit to reduce shootings, though it eventually collapsed. The gang has a multi-state presence across Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Connecticut, and Florida, and is currently led by Anibal 'Tuffy C' Santiago.
